# Bootstrap 5.3.8 (vendored)

- `css/bootstrap.min.css` and `js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js` from
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/`, downloaded 2026-11-14.
- Only change: the trailing `sourceMappingURL` comment was removed from each file,
  because the `.map` files aren't vendored (avoids 404s when DevTools is open).
- License: MIT (header kept in each file).
